notes.title: Western 1849 Reloaded version 1.2 is live!
notes.content:
[h1]What's new in ver. 1.2?[/h1]
[*] [b]LOOK MODE[/b] - aka the most requested feature by our users - the ability to look around when hiding behind covers! Now you're be able to see where those bandits are coming from even in the safe comforts of your cover!
[*] Gameplay balances and multiple BUG fixes.

Have fun playing [b]Western 1849 version 1.2[/b] and as always we are looking forward to seeing your reviews and suggestions for future updates!

notes.title: Bug fixes and balancing
notes.content:
In this update we adrresed the most common issues reported by our users including:

[h1]BUX fixes and game crashes[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]A Game Crash when using the "Auto Reload" functionality was fixed![/b]
(this should fix most of the reported game crashes)
[*]A bug  where [b]Golden Skull[/b] Item didn't gave you Rage Energy when starting a new level was fixed 
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Bullet Pack[/b] Item will now give you +5 Secondary Weapon Bullets per Wave instead of the flat 20 Bullets at the start of the game (until reaching the MAX Bullets limit in your weapon, remember that upgrading your secondary weapon will also increase your MAX Bullets count!) 
[*][b]Vlad the Guncula[/b] Perk now heals 2% of max HP instead of flat 2 HP for each kill  
[*]The values of Rage Energy refill for killing Bandits (when in Rage Mode) was tweaked (it is now harder to stay in Rage for long periods of time when using more devastating weapons)
[/list]

[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list] 
[*]We added a clear info in the tutorial on what exactly [b]Perfect Reload[/b] does! For those that already compleated the tutorial:
[b]Perfect Reload cuts down the reload time, gives you extra Damage and increases your Fire Rate[/b] until the next reload! 
[*]We tweaked [b]controls sensitivity[/b] settings for smoother and faster aiming experience (and users with extra high DPi mousses)! Please note that the new settings override previous ones so if you already customized yours you may need to tweak them again, sorry for any inconveniences)
[/list]

Have fun and thanks to all of our users for feedback on the game!

notes.title: Western 1849 Reloaded ver 1.1 is Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://giant.gfycat.com/WhisperedApprehensiveArctichare.gif[/img]

[h1]4 totally new Perk Cards![/h1]
[list]  
[*][b]Wolf in Sheep's Clothing[/b] - that gives you a duplicate of the last Perk you collected
[*][b]Dynamite Rodeo[/b] - gives you unlimited Dynamites for one wave
[*][b]Double Bounty[/b] - permanently increases your base Score Multiplier
[*][b]Wild Wild Wild West[/b] - gives you a random card of any tier  
[/list] 
  
[h1]Gameplay Balancing[/h1] 
[list] 
[*]you can now [b]start shooting much faster[/b] when leaving the cover  
[*]you can now change weapons much faster (primary/secondary)  
[*]TNT Bullets Perk Buff - the bullets now explode in much greater radius and give more DMG  
[*]Revolving Revolver now starts with full ammo Clip (no need to reload)  
[*]you will now get the full Perfect Reload Bonus (to Fire Rate & Damage) when using the Revolving Revolver Card for the whole wave  
[*]Duck Hunter Perk Buffed - will now give you 5 uses per Card  
[*] new particle effects for Dynamite Explosions, Mysterious Weapon of Mass Destruction and multiple Perk effects 
[*] multiple [b]tweaks in game economy system[/b] to ease the initial grind factor   
[*] the Bandits are now less annoying (in vocal department)!  
 [/list] 
 
[h1]Multiple BUG fixes including: [/h1] 
[list] 
[*] colliders fixes in the Old Canyon level  
[*] autodetected control method switch (you can now freely switch control scheme form mouse/keyboard to gamepad)  
[*] the crashes reported by our users when changing the levels & reloading should be fixed! (but if you'll have any problems with the game, please contact us at support@nawiagames.com)  
 [/list] 
 
Have fun playing [b]Western 1849 version 1.1[/b] and share your reviews and suggestions for future updates!
